scope: Static contracts recovered from identity-matched Minecraft Windows 1.26.51.1 (protocol2193). These are bounded paths, not a whole-client parity claim.

contracts.name: client_dispatch
contracts.description: Resolves target actor. When event is nonzero, tick is nonzero, and ReplayStateComponent exists, constructs MobEffectsReplay and applies a frame correction. Otherwise invokes immediate packet-effect helper.

contracts.name: recognized_events
contracts.description: Events1 and2 share Actor::addEffect. Event3 calls Actor::removeEffect. Other byte event values produce no effect mutation in this helper; historical advanceFrame has the same event split.

contracts.name: duration_at_reception
contracts.description: If packet tick is nonzero and older than current replay tick, finite duration is shortened by elapsed ticks and floored at0. Duration-1 remains infinite. A zero or future/equal timestamp leaves the full received duration for immediate live application.

contracts.name: live_merge
contracts.description: A higher amplifier replaces amplifier,duration,ambient. Equal amplifier replaces duration and ambient only when extending finite duration or upgrading finite to-1. Existing-1 cannot be shortened by equal amplifier. Weaker amplifier never changes magnitude/duration. An incoming nonambient effect clears ambient when duration is not replaced. Particle visibility is copied regardless of replacement.

contracts.name: historical_merge
contracts.description: History::MobEffectsReplay::advanceFrame merges amplifier/duration using the same priority and infinity rules against the historical component. Its constructed historical MobEffectInstance uses ambient=false; live application uses the packet ambient field.

contracts.name: live_and_history_application
contracts.description: ReplayStateComponent::_applyCorrection calls advanceLiveFrame directly, then may attach the correction to the following historical frame. MobEffectsReplay::advanceLiveFrame tailcalls the live effect helper; it does not wait for a future packet tick. Full later component reconciliation has not been reconstructed.

contracts.name: duration_countdown
contracts.description: MobEffectsTick registered by TickMobEffectsSystem uses vtable0xea51f30,tick0x90d84d0,callback0x90d80d0. Counter-paused-this-tick clears/skips. Duration-1 is retained. Other nonzero durations decrement by1. Effects with prior duration<=1, including0, are queued for removal. Exact intra-tick placement and all pause producers remain unverified.

contracts.name: integer_widths
contracts.description: The packet/helper and MobEffectInstance use full32-bit effect ID and signed32-bit amplifier. No narrowing to8-bit was observed on these paths. This does not establish validity of every out-of-range effect ID or amplifier.

remaining_limits: Exact effect processing/order for protocol944 and2225 has not been independently recovered from matching executables.
Effect counter pause producers and the precise same-tick removal/physics order remain unresolved.
